title: Credit Suisse Real Returns: restart your career
description: Deciding to return back to work may be a challenging decision after taking a voluntarily leave from the workforce. Our Real Returns program opens the door to see what it's like today and find out what it feels like to come back while leveraging a strong support network. To learn more, please visit http://www.credit-suisse.com/realreturns  Interested in working with us? Visit our website for more information: http://www.credit-suisse.com/careers   Subscribe to our channel: http://www.youtube.com/subscription_c...   Connect with us on:  Twitter: http://www.twitter.com/creditsuisse  Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/creditsuisse

asr.full_text: I wanted to return back to work because I really missed the challenge and. Excitement of working in a corporate environment and at a bank. I always felt. Like a fish out of water when I was at home, never felt fully comfortable. I. Appreciated the time off but I knew that I would be going back to work someday. I. I decided to return because I thought it was high time that I gave my career a restart. I felt I was no more at my place at home and this is why I thought it was the right time for me to come back to work. Starting a new position is always a scary thing, coming back after a break even more so. The Real Return Programme provides you with a protective umbrella. The programme is widely known and everyone tries to support and help you in your process of coming back to work. I got an opportunity to upgrade and refresh my skills. The programme provided me with a lot of confidence that I could balance both my work as well as family. I realised that there was still something left for me to do and there was still some fire in my belly to get on with it. In fact, the transition was so seamless that it was as if I never left. We can help women here by retraining them, we can support them by having mentors, access. To senior management and dedicated HR staff. The Real Return label is a great door opener and makes it easy to approach people and to. Expand your network throughout the bank. I had a phenomenal mentor. She was always available immediately every time I asked for help. She was passionate and fun, pragmatic, excited and encouraging. The biggest reward of the program is the access and the ability to connect and form networks. Across the firm. So it was very helpful to be surrounded by other women going through the same thing and. People working on the program that were so supportive that enabled us to feel. Pretty quickly that yeah of course it didn't go away it's still there. Participating in the Real Return program is like taking part in a class. You're. Surrounded by peers in the same situation and together you are on this. Amazing journey. I was really lucky. My project manager and my team embraced me immediately. So I was immediately embraced and felt a big part of that team. My project manager has been encouraging and engaging from day one. I felt particularly fortunate that the nature of the project I was working on was of such. High priority and high profile. The projects were very real, very tangible and very material to the business. I was able to meet many senior people and they were delighted to meet me, happy to give. Me time and delighted to support the programme and me as an individual. You.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents Credit Suisse’s Real Returns program as a route back into employment through retraining, mentoring, networking, and confidence-building. The recruitment and training visuals, career-information links, and channel-subscription request do not show a payment requirement, credential request, investment solicitation, or evidence-supported deceptive mechanism.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary content is an employment and professional-development program describing retraining, skill refreshment, mentoring, networking and participation in business projects.
